error[ZBX-E0301]: can't reach the systemd user manager over D-Bus
  while  starting container web-1
  while  starting the container's scope zbx-web-1.scope
  cause  connecting to the user bus failed: no such file or directory (ENOENT)
  cause  the bus socket does not exist: this login has no systemd user session
  scope  zbx-web-1.scope
  name   web-1
  rootfs /srv/alpine
  step   start_scope (5 of 48)
  fix    check this host (ZBX-E0103):     zbx doctor
         keep the user manager running:   loginctl enable-linger $USER
  more   zbx explain E0301
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0301.html
